title: Italian Apprentice
description: Cook traditional Italian recipes to master classic pasta and sauce techniques. Earned by finishing the Italian Cuisine module.

title: Salsa & Street Food Explorer
description: Master bold charred chilies, citrus marinades, and fresh salsa preparation. Earned by finishing the Mexican Cuisine module.

title: Wok & Flavor Master
description: Master traditional Chinese cooking techniques, from high-heat stir-frying to aromatic sauces and balanced seasoning. Earned by finishing the Chinese Cuisine module.

title: Spice & Curry Artisan
description: Explore the art of Indian cooking through spice tempering, layered curry bases, and aromatic spice blends. Earned by finishing the Indian Cuisine module.

title: American Comfort Food Champion
description: Master classic American cooking techniques, from grilling and searing to smoky barbecue and hearty comfort food. Earned by finishing the American Cuisine module.

title: Blade Runner
description: Complete practice recipes focused on precision knife skills and prep work. Earned by finishing the Knife Skills module.

title: Flame Tamer
description: Master pan control and flame management across practice recipes. Earned by finishing the Heat & Pan Control module.

title: Simmering Specialist
description: Master liquid temperature control, from rolling boils to gentle simmering, and learn to cook pasta, grains, and soups with the right texture. Earned by finishing the Boiling & Simmering module.

title: Whisk Taker
description: Master the art of mixing, whisking, folding, and combining ingredients to achieve smooth mixtures and the right consistency. Earned by finishing the Mixing & Whisking module.

title: Oven Virtuoso
description: Master oven cooking fundamentals, from preparing baking trays to roasting ingredients evenly and achieving the right doneness. Earned by finishing the Oven Roasting & Baking module.

title: Home Chef
description: Cook meals across any cuisine or skill category. Earned by completing a total of 1, 5, 10, and 25 recipes.

title: Consistent Cook
description: Maintain your cooking streak by logging completed recipes back-to-back. Earned by maintaining a streak for 3, 7, 14, and 30 days.

title: Dedicated Grinder
description: Advance through the levels of culinary expertise. Earned by reaching higher levels in your cooking journey.
